tha-ap328:1.1: Annasaṃsāvaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantam antarāpaṇe / kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ battiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ // //
tha-ap328:2.1: Siddhatthaṃ sabbasiddhattham anejam aparājitaṃ / sambuddham atināmetvā bhojayin taṃ mahamuniṃ. // //
tha-ap328:3.1: Muni kāruṇiko loke obhāsayi mamaṃ tadā / Buddhe cittaṃ pasādetvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap328:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhikkhadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap328:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Annasaṃsāvako thero i. g. a-ti.
